verdict.rationale: LocalAI's getting-started docs show a direct `local-ai run huggingface://<repo>/<file>.gguf` command, which downloads and runs an open model straight from Hugging Face. Related model-acquisition features, the built-in gallery and preloading via /models/apply, round this out. The Hugging Face path itself is evidenced only by a single command example. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on Hugging Face sourcing (supported formats beyond GGUF, gated/private repo authentication, file selection) and independent or hands-on corroboration.
